Abacos #305 by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 You can’t beat the amazing location of this recently renovated luxury townhome. Abacos #305 is directly across from Ed Walline, the biggest public beach access on 30A, and a short walk to some of the best shopping, entertainment, and dining, so no need to drive anywhere! The bottom floor of Abacos features Pecan Jacks (voted best ice cream and candy on 30A), a surf shop, a nail salon and spa, and the lively Growler Garage tap room. Next door is Shunk Gulley, one of the most popular and fun 30A restaurants, with live music. Just across the street from Shunk Gulley is the colorful Gulf Place community, with several delicious restaurants like the Perfect Pig, Pizza By The Sea, and Shelby’s Bar and Grill. Sunrise Coffee is there, as well as YOLO, the best place to rent paddle boards and electric bikes. Also, take advantage of the nearby liquor store, convenience store, artist circle, boutique shops, and a large grass lawn. Talk about convenience! Inside, the professionally decorated, 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath, getaway is perfect for entertaining or just relaxing on the large balconies. The upstairs living room features a 70” smart TV with cable, so you can use your own Netflix, Hulu, or other favorite streaming account.

The balcony is the ideal place to enjoy morning coffee, or evening drinks, with views of the fabulous beach! The kitchen is fully stocked, and the stylish dining room comfortably seats 8, with additional bar stools at the breakfast counter. The workspace area is for those who need to finish up some work before venturing out. The primary bedroom, king, has its own balcony, and the second and third bedrooms feature WiFi, cable TV, plenty of storage, and easy bathroom access. A full-size washer and dryer, standard and Keurig coffee maker, blender, walk-in closets, and luxury linens are just some of the amenities we provide to make your stay as comfortable and convenient as possible. Your home is secured with a key/code entry only. On-site assigned parking for 1 vehicle (there is one assigned parking spot for each unit, and some extra visitor spots) is immediately available behind the community and next to your community pool. Limited number of vehicles to no more than 2. Two bikes are included, perfect for exploring 30A! The Timpoochee Trail is a beautiful 19-mile paved bike trail that runs along the entire length of 30A and takes you through all the different eclectic little beach towns along the way. Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - Gulf views - 67 steps to the closet beach access (Ed Walline Public Beach Access) - On-site parking limited to one vehicle, with additional visitor spots available - 3 bedrooms, 2.5 baths - 1952 sq ft - Community Pool - Wi-Fi - 2 bikes included Overnight: - King in 1st floor primary bedroom; private bath; TV - Two fulls in 1st floor guest bedroom; bath; TV - King in 1st floor guest bedroom; shared bath; TV Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
